name: lazaretto-guard
description: Before an install runs, check the pinned package versions in the command against published malicious-package advisories, and ask rather than block on a match. The same check runs on the package behind `claude mcp add`, `npx`, and an MCP server written into .mcp.json, where no advisory lookup happens today. Sends package names and versions and nothing else. Never blocks, never exits non-zero, 2 second hook timeout.
